newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar prices ease, lower consumer demand.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar prices ease, lower consumer demand.

text.p: Bombay sugar prices on Monday eased on lower consumer demand, dealers said.
Retail demand also fell at ae higher level while stockists booking profits.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 5/30 rupees at 1,465/1,480 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 fell by eight rupees at 1,490/1,532 rupees.
"Improved arrivals also dragged prices lower today," one broker said.
Millers turned active sellers due to the absence of outstation buying which in turn improved sugar inflows from mills to the Bombay market.
In mill delivery, sugar S-30 fell to 1,395/1,405 rupees per quintal from 1,415/1,425 rupees. Sugar M-30 also fell to 1,415/1,435 rupees per quintal from 1,435/1,455 rupees.
